name: janumi-professional-workbench
description: Janumi Professional Workbench (JPWB) — the Recursive Professional Harness (RPH) engine, a host-agnostic TypeScript core library.

scripts.check-types: turbo run check-types && tsc --noEmit -p verif/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: turbo run test && bun run test:dist
scripts.test:dist: turbo run build && vitest run --config vitest.dist.config.ts
scripts.gate: bun run gate:fast && bun run mutants
scripts.gate:fast: bun run check-types && bun run lint && bun run boundary && bun run build && bun run test && bun run test:coverage && cd apps/rph-demo && bun run check && bun run e2e
